entity_name: Person in the synthetic kitchen camera
discovery_prompt: Report a food_service_worker Profile hit whenever this image contains a person. Discovery is based on presence only.
grounding_prompt: Locate every visible person independently in the original frame. Return distinct original-image boxes [x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max] for all persons.

questions.prompt: Inspect only the highlighted person's face. Answer face_assessable if the face and nose/mouth area are clear enough to assess a worn mask, including if a mask clearly covers that area. Answer face_not_assessable for blur or obstruction. Return insufficient_visibility if the target cannot be identified.
questions.region_prompt: Inspect the face of the person at the supplied coordinates. Use face_assessable when the nose and mouth area allows a mask assessment, including clear mask coverage. Use face_not_assessable for blur or obstruction and insufficient_visibility when the person cannot be identified.

questions.prompt: Inspect only the highlighted person's face. Answer not_wearing_mask only if the person's nose and mouth area is assessable and no mask is worn across it. Answer wearing_mask if a mask clearly covers both the nose and mouth. Answer insufficient_visibility if the face is occluded, too small, blurred, or the mask is partly worn.
questions.region_prompt: Inspect the same person's face. Use wearing_mask when a mask clearly covers the nose and mouth. Use not_wearing_mask when the area is clear and no mask is worn across it. Use insufficient_visibility for an occluded, small or blurred face, or a partly worn mask.
